text.t:
A transparent globe full of magic, with artificial snow inside and a special photograph that transforms each piece into a unique and meaningful keepsake.
The delicate golden bow adds a touch of elegance and sophistication, making this decoration even more enchanting.
Perfect for eternalising special moments, decorating the Christmas tree, or gifting to someone dear, with a photograph that will stay in the heart forever.

options.name.help.t: The photograph is sent after the order: simply reply to the confirmation email with it.

gpsr.warnings.0.t: It is an ornament and not a toy: hang it out of reach of small children, who may put it in their mouths.
